title: Recover the same private credit commitment after interruption
description: Four independent authenticated commanders enter a real development campaign. Sender, recipient and outsider inspect private credit commitments, reservations and authoritative outcomes. The development mock provider exercises real encrypted ingress, canonical persistence and recipient grants. Fixed domain clocks and tick-service delivery are explicit harness controls. Eight-tick expiry and settlement ordering remain proposed rules, not owner approval. Managed-key and hosted acceptance remain separate.
